author: Top Gear
description:
Gordon Murray’s modern interpretation of the McLaren F1, the GMA T.50 road car, is sublime – and now there’s a version only for the track! It’s lighter, louder, faster, more downforce hungry and 100% less road legal, and in this world-exclusive review of the new GMA T.50s Niki Lauda, we drive it flat-out at a Formula 1-grade race circuit. Volume up, too, for the unfettered 761bhp V12 that revs to over 12,000rpm!

🚗 GMA T.50s Niki Lauda
🎤 Jethro Bovingdon
